decl_list->:decl_list:decl
decl_list->:decl
decl->:record_decl
decl->:proc_decl
record_decl->:KW_RECORD:ID:LPAREN:param_list:RPAREN
param_list->:id_list
param_list->
id_list->:id_list:COMMA:ID
id_list->:ID
proc_decl->:KW_PROCEDURE:ID:LPAREN:param_list:RPAREN:opt_local:stmt_list:KW_END
opt_local->:KW_LOCAL:id_list
opt_local->
stmt_list->:stmt_list:stmt
stmt_list->:stmt
stmt->:expr
stmt->:if_stmt
stmt->:while_stmt
stmt->:return_stmt
if_stmt->:KW_IF:expr:KW_THEN:block
if_stmt->:KW_IF:expr:KW_THEN:block:KW_ELSE:block
if_stmt->:KW_IF:expr:KW_THEN:block:KW_ELSE:if_stmt
while_stmt->:KW_WHILE:expr:KW_DO:block
